title: The response shapes of the job read, the rerun answer and the freshness answer are not specified
source: RWB-AD-018 legacy AC1 and endpoints table; TSD P1 v3 Appendix T-A API-P1-001, API-P1-002 and API-P1-009
section: Legacy RWB-AD-018 AC1; TSD P1 v3 T-A.2
description: The legacy story names the three operations and the entities they read (job_catalog, data_product_load, v_ace_batch_status) but gives no response field list, no job-log field list and no paging. TSD P1 v3 T-A.2 gives the purpose, the query parameters and the error codes of API-P1-001, API-P1-002 and API-P1-009 only. No source gives the JSON field names or the job-log columns of the target.
evidence: Legacy RWB-AD-018 Endpoints table: GET /api/recovery/v1/admin/jobs, POST /api/recovery/v1/admin/jobs/{jobId}/rerun, GET /api/recovery/v1/data-products/freshness. TSD P1 v3 T-A.2 API-P1-001 Response: Job[]; API-P1-002 Response: Job.
proposed: Fix the answer fields from the legacy Data table by field ID (DF-OPS-224 to DF-OPS-232, DF-OPS-001 to DF-OPS-008, DF-ACE-178 to DF-ACE-186) and publish them in RWB-P1-AD018-CON.

title: job_catalog is P2 rwb-integration while the job read is P1 rwb-source-data
source: Ownership Map v1 job_catalog (owner P2; ASM-A6-tables-9); Architecture v5 slide 44 job map; legacy RWB-AD-018 AC1
description: The legacy AC1 says the monitor lists the jobs of the job catalog, but the Ownership Map puts job_catalog with P2 rwb-integration and the job read with P1. The source does not say whether P1 joins the catalog by table, reads it through P2's contract, or lists only the jobs it owns.
evidence: Ownership Map tables.job_catalog.owner = P2, ruling: job_catalog stays with P2 rwb-integration; Architecture v5 slide 44: each job runs in its owning service as a Temporal Schedule or an event-started workflow.
proposed: P1 lists the Workbench jobs it owns from its own job map and the ACE batch record; a catalog field is read through P2's contract only, never by table.

title: SCR-44 is a gateway-bff route on a P1 story that builds no screen
source: Template and Rules v1 §R5.5 DP-19; Architecture v5 slides 24 and 45; legacy RWB-AD-018 screen table
section: WP B-P1-03 patterns; Arch v5 slide 45
description: The Work Package lists DP-19 on RWB-P1-AD018-APP, RWB-P1-AD018-CON and RWB-P1-AD018-OPS, while SCR-44 Interface and job monitor is a gateway-bff composite route and the legacy story builds no screen of its own. No source says which of the three P1 stories provisions the route against RWB-PLT-N001-CON.
evidence: Legacy RWB-AD-018 Screen and states: SCR-44 Interface and job monitor. Template and Rules §R5.5 DP-19: Screen, ace-web -> gateway-bff composite route, H RWB-PLT-N001-CON.
proposed: The APP story serves the reads, the CON story publishes them and the OPS story registers the gateway-bff route and its alerts.

title: The ACE migration version and the interface numbers of the 14 ingestion jobs are not specified for the target
source: RWB-ACE-001 legacy flow step 1 and AC1 (V027__rwb_ace_001_recovery_source_additions.sql); TSD P1 v3 T3.2
description: The legacy story fixes V027 on the monolith ACE schema sequence and leaves the 14 ingestion job numbers to the ACE team. The target adds one schema and one login per service, so the numbering of the ACE migration and the interface identifiers of the 14 jobs are not given by any source.
evidence: Legacy RWB-ACE-001 section 4 step 1: applies migration V027__rwb_ace_001_recovery_source_additions.sql in DEV. Section 12 step 2: one Spring Batch job per source. TSD P1 v3 T5.1: the interface numbers of the new ACE interfaces are in Interface Specifications v3.
proposed: Keep V027 as the legacy file name and let the ACE DBA allocates the version on the ACE schema's own sequence at build time; record each job's interface number from Interface Specifications v3.

title: The legacy grant names the monolith service role, the target names ace_view_owner and 19 logins
source: RWB-ACE-001 AC4 and section 12 step 4; TSD P1 v3 T6.3; Template and Rules v1 §R5.5 DP-02
section: Legacy RWB-ACE-001 AC4; TSD P1 v3 T6.3
description: The legacy story grants SELECT to the view-owner role agreed with the monolith environment and covers the 12 new columns with the existing Tier 1 grant. In the target the views are owned by ace_view_owner and each of the 19 services reads them on its own login (DP-02), so which role holds SELECT on the 14 tables and on the 12 columns is stated twice and differently.
evidence: Legacy RWB-ACE-001 AC4: the role may select the 14 new tables and no other table. TSD P1 v3 T6.3: ace_view_owner holds SELECT on the 22 Tier 1 ACE tables and on the Tier 2 tables once RWB-ACE-001 lands; the recovery service identity holds SELECT on the views only.
proposed: Grant SELECT on the 14 tables and on the 12 columns to ace_view_owner only; the service logins keep SELECT on the views and no public grant.

title: The shape of the reconciliation read and of the REC-05 break list is not specified
source: TSD P1 v3 Appendix T-A API-P1-003; legacy RWB-AD-019 AC1 and AC2; RWB-P3-AD019-APP preconditions
section: TSD P1 v3 T-A.1 and T-A.2; legacy RWB-AD-019
description: The legacy console has no endpoint; it reads the reconciliation and data quality extract that JOB-04 writes. API-P1-003 keeps its identifier and changes path and purpose, but no source gives the response fields, the paging or the break-list row shape that the console and the ITG harness read.
evidence: TSD P1 v3 T-A.1: API-P1-003 GET /admin/reconciliation/results, Platform administration R. Legacy RWB-AD-019 Endpoints: No endpoint in this story. RWB-P3-AD019-APP precondition: the path, paging and field shape of the reconciliation read are Not specified in the source documents.
proposed: Answer from reconciliation_result by field ID (DF-OPS-118 to DF-OPS-129) plus the REC-05 orphan rows, and publish the shape in the P1 service contract.

title: DP-10 is listed on the P1 slice while JOB-04 is an event-started workflow and the freshness Schedule is rwb-case's
source: Template and Rules v1 §R5.5 DP-10; Architecture v5 slide 44; RWB-P3-AD019-APP section 12.6
section: WP B-P1-03 patterns; Arch v5 slide 44
description: The Work Package lists DP-10 (Quartz, JOB-nn to Temporal Schedule or event-started workflow) on RWB-P1-AD019-APP and RWB-P1-AD019-OPS. Architecture v5 slide 44 records JOB-04 as an event-triggered workflow in rwb-source-data, and the console's freshness Schedule runs in rwb-case. The source does not say which P1 job becomes a Schedule and which stays event-started.
evidence: Architecture v5 slide 44: JOB-04 Reconciliation, when Airflow ACE data ready, owner rwb-source-data, mechanism event-triggered workflow; JOB-05 retired. RWB-P3-AD019-APP section 12.6: the 15-minute DataQualityFreshnessCheck Schedule is in rwb-case.
proposed: P1 starts JOB-04 from AceDataReady on the workflow kit and runs no Temporal Schedule of its own for the console.

title: The case and ownership tables are P3's while the legacy migration and its AC1 and AC3 sit on the P1 slice
source: Ownership Map v1 recovery_case, case_account, case_party and assignment (owner P3); WP B-P1-03 story line RWB-P1-DM003-APP; legacy RWB-DM-003 Data table
description: The legacy story sits in the P1 Recovery data engine module and loads recovery_case, case_account, case_party and assignment. The Ownership Map puts all four tables with P3 rwb-case. The Work Package gives AC1 and AC3 of the legacy key to RWB-P1-DM003-APP, and no source says who performs the load into rwb_case or how P1 reaches it without a cross-schema write.
evidence: Ownership Map: recovery_case owner P3, case_account owner P3, case_party owner P3, assignment owner P3, basis Architecture v5 slide 41 and TSD P3 v3 T3.1. Legacy RWB-DM-003 Data table lists the same four tables. RWB-ITG-DM003-ITG section 1: the real records are loaded by P3's own cutover migration on its own Flyway sequence.
proposed: P1 produces the cutover extract and the business-key mapping; rwb-case loads the rows into rwb_case through its own migration; P1 writes no other service's schema.

title: The source, format and evidence of the legacy Workbench extract and of the cutover sign-off are not specified
source: Legacy RWB-DM-003 AC1, AC3 and Endpoints; Architecture v5 slide 32 one-off bulk work
description: The legacy story says the migration reads the legacy Workbench records and that the data steward signs off after ten clean days, but no source gives the extract's source (dump, file or API), its format, where it is held, or where the sign-off is recorded. Architecture v5 slide 32 puts cutover loads through service APIs and forbids a schedule reading rwb_* schemas.
evidence: Legacy RWB-DM-003 AC1: the migration reads the legacy Workbench case, case account, case party and assignment records. AC3: the data steward signs off. Endpoints: No endpoint in this story. Architecture v5 slide 32: one-off bulk work through service APIs, never their schemas.
proposed: Read the extract once through the cutover run, land nothing in rwb_source_data, and hold the sign-off in the cutover record of the release pipeline with the reconciliation results as evidence.

title: The treatment table is S2's and the DP04 copy is P1's, while the legacy migration and its AC1 and AC3 sit on the P1 slice
source: Ownership Map v1 treatment (owner S2) and dp_treatment (owner P1, ruling ASM-A6-tables-14); legacy RWB-DM-004 Data table
description: The legacy story loads treatment records and reads v_ace_plan. The Ownership Map puts the live treatment records with S2 rwb-treatment and the dated DP04 copies with P1 rwb-source-data. The Work Package gives AC1 and AC3 of the legacy key to RWB-P1-DM004-APP, and no source says who loads the treatment rows into rwb_treatment or how the DP04 copy is fed.
evidence: Ownership Map: treatment owner S2; dp_treatment owner P1 with ruling that the live records stay with S2 and the dated DP04 copies stay with P1, built from events and read-only for reporting. Legacy RWB-DM-004 Data table: recovery_case, treatment, v_ace_plan.
proposed: P1 extracts and maps the legacy treatment and approval records and reads v_ace_plan; rwb-treatment loads; the DP04 copies are built from events, not from the extract.

title: The treatment extract format and the carrying of the plan reference are not specified beyond AC1
source: Legacy RWB-DM-004 AC1 and Data table; TSD P1 v3 T3.3 view 16 (v_ace_plan)
section: Legacy RWB-DM-004; TSD P1 v3 T3.3
description: The legacy AC1 requires each treatment to keep its case, type, offer amount, approval level and outcome and to read the plan it refers to from v_ace_plan, with no plan copied and none booked. No source gives the extract's format, the field list beyond the AC wording, or the plan key that is carried.
evidence: Legacy RWB-DM-004 AC1 and Data table (treatment DF-TRT-001 to DF-TRT-033; v_ace_plan DF-ACE-160 to DF-ACE-177). TSD P1 v3 T3.3 view 16 key: plan_ref, account_key.
proposed: Carry v_ace_plan.plan_ref as the plan link, read only; the extract is a one-off cutover read that lands nothing in rwb_source_data.
